entry.title: Covenant Farming
entry.summary: Farming everything you can get from Covenants is a headache. First of all, there's a lot to get. Then, it's really only efficient to have a character focus on one Covenant, considering the investment required to upgrade buildings (which increase your anima gain from various forms…
entry.content:
Farming everything you can get from Covenants is a headache. First of all, there's a lot to get. Then, it's really only efficient to have a character focus on one Covenant, considering the investment required to upgrade buildings (which increase your anima gain from various forms of content). Then, there's even more - items that only drop for certain specs, ensembles that can only be learned by some classes, and then items that can be acquired from more than one covenant, but which one does it the easiest?

Where to even begin?

General Overview

Let's try and classify the different type of loot restrictions we have to deal with:

  • Loot dropping from various building content, such as the Anima Conductor or the Transport Network, can be armor type-restricted or spec-restricted.
  • Lots of stuff dropping from The Avowed content in Revendreth (with several kinds of restrictions) can more easily be farmed by a Venthyr character with a built up Ember Court.
  • Some Ensembles (like the Court of Night ones) require both the appropriate armor class and being a Night Fae Covenant member to learn.

In an ideal world, you'd have all 12 Shadowlands classes for each Covenant and just take it from there, but that's not only excessive but extremely boring to set up. Thus, to try and simplify this, this guide will break down everything that requires a specific class or spec or armor type. See the table below for a summary of where you should send who, and read further below to get an overview of all content that has those restrictions.

The following table is ordered by how much a class can farm from a Covenant. It does not take into account systems like the Abomination Factory of the Venthyr's Transport Network, which requires 4 characters to complete in full, though it does for example consider the 4 daggers from the Transport Network. It was created with the following considerations:

  • The 1st choice can farm the most loot-restricted content. It is the character to invest the most Anima on, for buildings and such.
  • The 2nd choice always has access to some loot-restricted content.
  • The 3rd and 4th choices either also have access to some loot-restricted content, or are just there to fill in an armor class requirement. In some cases, the 3rd and 4th choices are of equal relevance.
  KYRIAN NECROLORD NIGHT FAE VENTHYR
1ST CHOICE Warrior Paladin Any Plate Rogue
2ND CHOICE Shaman Any Cloth Monk Shaman / Evoker
3RD CHOICE Any Leather Shaman / Evoker Druid Any Cloth
4TH CHOICE Any Cloth Monk / Druid Any Cloth Any Plate

Table of Contents

  • General Overview
  • The Kyrian
  • The Necrolords
  • Night Fae
  • Venthyr
    • The Ember Court & The Avowed
  • Other Considerations

The Kyrian

  • Anima Conductor
    • Tier 1: https://www.wowhead.com/object=356818/penitence-of-purity contains https://www.wowhead.com/item=184296/puritys-edge-greatblade, only lootable by Plate classes.
    • Tier 3: https://www.wowhead.com/npc=156340/larionrider-orstus drops https://www.wowhead.com/item=184365/aegis-of-salvation only for Paladins, Warriors and Shamans.
  • Path of Ascension (Special Building)
    • Thankfully, once you build Tier 5, you can purchase all building-related rewards and learn them on any character, except the Ensembles, which you can mail to other Kyrian alts of the proper armor type.
    • In addition, this is the only special Covenant building where you can purchase the shared "special Covenant building" rewards for Anima, while it's quite RNG-based for the other Covenants.
  • In Korthia, the https://www.wowhead.com/npc=180032/wild-worldcracker rare event can only be started by a Kyrian and drops  https://www.wowhead.com/item=187380/devourer-hide-belt. 

There are no loot restricted rewards associated with the Kyrians' Transport Network.

The Necrolords

  • Anima Conductor
    • Tier 1: https://www.wowhead.com/object=355035/chosen-runecoffer drops https://www.wowhead.com/item=183622/grand-runespeakers-staff for Cloth classes, Evokers, Monks, Shamans and Druids.
    • Tier 1: https://www.wowhead.com/npc=162741/gieger drops https://www.wowhead.com/item=184298/amalgamated-forsworns-journal for all of the above classes, as well as Paladins and Demon Hunters.
    • Tier 3: https://www.wowhead.com/npc=168147/sabriel-the-bonecleaver drops https://www.wowhead.com/item=184291/tempered-boneplate-waistguard.
  • Abomination Factory (Special Building)
    • This one is the big nightmare folks.
    • Each NPC with a weekly quest has one or more cosmetic items that can randomly show up as a quest reward. Most of them award a cosmetic with an armor type for each class.
    • When reaching Tier 5 you unlock the ability to get Unity set piece cosmetic rewards from some World Quests.
      • You must have the Unity companion with you, active, while doing the quest.
      • This reward is hidden until the World Quest is complete.
      • The cosmetic will be one you haven't learned.
      • There is a Unity set for each armor type.
      • I highly suggest finding Discord servers where folks announce when they happen upon a World Quest with this hidden reward.
    • Basically, you need one character of each armor type to get a total of 2 cosmetic sets each:
      • One from weekly NPC quests, with more NPCs unlocking as you upgrade this building.
      • One from the Unity system, which unlocks at Tier 5. Yes, you have to grind the Anima and Souls to max this building 4 times.
  • The https://www.wowhead.com/object=352086/blackhound-cache event that starts with donating cloth to https://www.wowhead.com/npc=157843/visectus contains https://www.wowhead.com/item=183619/everlasting-boneforged-greataxe, only lootable by Plate classes.
  • In Korthia, the https://www.wowhead.com/npc=180042/fleshwing rare event can only be started by a Necrolord and drops https://www.wowhead.com/item=187372/miasma-filtering-headpiece.

Night Fae

  • Anima Conductor
    • Tier 1: The Star Lake Amphitheater spawns a random rare once per day. There's no deterministic way to get the one you need. Two of them drop loot-restricted transmog:
      • https://www.wowhead.com/npc=166135/astra-as-azshara drops https://www.wowhead.com/item=179518/glimmerlight-staff (Cloth classes, Evokers, Monks, Shamans, Druids)
      • https://www.wowhead.com/npc=166138/mikai-as-argus-the-unmaker drops https://www.wowhead.com/item=179534/mikais-deathscythe (Druids, Hunters, Monks)
    • Tier 3: https://www.wowhead.com/npc=168647/valfir-the-unrelenting drops https://www.wowhead.com/item=180154/greataxe-of-unrelenting-pursuit (Plate classes)
  • In Korthia, the https://www.wowhead.com/npc=180013/escaped-wilderling rare event can only be started by a Night Fae and drops https://www.wowhead.com/item=187395/reinforced-stygian-spaulders.

The Transport Network and Queen's Conservatory (Special Building) do not have any loot-restricted drops, though it is worth mentioning there's some exclusive random drops from Conservatory content (like https://www.wowhead.com/item=187705/choofas-call) that are worth targeting early, relying on the Kyrian special building to grab most of the shared loot.

Venthyr

  • Anima Conductor
    • Tier 1: https://www.wowhead.com/npc=165290/harika-the-horrid drops https://www.wowhead.com/item=183720/dredbatskin-jerkin for Leather classes.
    • Tier 3: https://www.wowhead.com/npc=159496/forgemaster-madalav drops https://www.wowhead.com/npc=159496/forgemaster-madalav for Plate classes.
  • Transport Network
    • Another rough one, dwarfed only by the horror that is the Necrolords' Abomination Factory.
    • All of the following rewards are only attainable when the building is Tier 3.
    • As part of the Mirror Restoration daily minigame, each restored mirror's reward can contain a cosmetic armor piece. Of course, these can only drop for the character's armor type, meaning you need 4 characters to farm this in full.
    • In addition, four daggers can drop:
      • https://www.wowhead.com/item=183972/forgotten-venthyr-winged-kris?bonus=6659 and https://www.wowhead.com/item=183978/silver-etched-hopebreaker-dirk exclusively for Rogues.
      • https://www.wowhead.com/item=183973/lost-winged-ritual-kris?bonus=6659 and https://www.wowhead.com/item=183976/rogue-researchers-dagger drop for Cloth classes, Druids, Shamans, Evokers and Demon Hunters.
  • The Ember Court (Special Building)
    • Some items whose source is shared between special Covenant buildings are, for some mystical reason, not avilable for purchase from the Kyrian special building. Running the Ember Court is the cheapest, easiest way to obtain them. They are:
      • https://www.wowhead.com/item=181235/final-arbiters-gavel#contained-in-item 
      • https://www.wowhead.com/item=181225/crossbow-of-contemplative-calm#contained-in-object 
      • https://www.wowhead.com/item=181228/temple-guards-partisan#contained-in-object 
      • https://www.wowhead.com/item=181227/bronze-ceremonial-targe#contained-in-object 
      • https://www.wowhead.com/item=181231/broadbladed-severer 
      • https://www.wowhead.com/item=181229/tranquils-censer 

This Ember Court section needs citation as I've got all those appearances and I only ran Ember Court on a Demon Hunter, Queen's Conservatory on a Mage, and never bought Abomination Factory loot boxes. How did I get these? Are they not class/spec-restricted?

  • In Korthia, the https://www.wowhead.com/npc=179985/stygian-stonecrusher rare event can only be started by a Venthyr and drops https://www.wowhead.com/item=187386/stygian-crystal-studded-legguards.

The Ember Court & The Avowed

There's no better way to farm reputation and cosmetics from The Avowed faction than by using a Venthyr. By inviting Cryptkeeper Kassir to your party, you can farm a boatload of stuff from https://www.wowhead.com/object=356752/cryptkeeper-kassirs-extravagant-tribute :

  • Sinstones of any quality for summoning rares.
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=172957/atonement-crypt-key 
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=172965/sinstone-fragments (needs citation)

In fact, if you're looking to target farm a specific Inquisitor and their sinstone, do the following:

  • Keep having parties with Cryptkeeper Kassir.
  • Loot his tribute, getting a random sinstone each time.
    • You'll always get a sinstone you do not currently have.
  • When you have all but one sinstone, you can guarantee you'll always get that particular sinstone in his tribute.

Luckily, he's also a Tier 1 guest, meaning you can run this on several characters with little upfront cost. This is extremely important as Inquistors have a ridiculous amount of low-drop cosmetics. Aside from way too many cloaks to list here, they may also drop:

  • Common low-level Inquisitor drops:
    • https://www.wowhead.com/item=180493/inquisitors-robes?bonus=1679:1686:1693:1700:1707:1714 
    • https://www.wowhead.com/item=184213/ritualists-soles?bonus=1679:1686:1693:1700:1707:1714 
    • https://www.wowhead.com/item=184214/chained-manacles?bonus=1679:1686:1693:1700:1707:1714 
    • https://www.wowhead.com/item=184217/sinstone-stompers?bonus=1679:1686:1693:1700:1707:1714 
  • Common High Inquisitor drops:
    • https://www.wowhead.com/item=184211/high-inquisitors-banded-cincture 
    • https://www.wowhead.com/item=184212/intimidator-trainers-cuffs 
    • https://www.wowhead.com/item=184214/chained-manacles?bonus=1679:1686:1693:1700:1707:1714 (again)
    • https://www.wowhead.com/item=184215/depraved-houndmasters-grips 
    • https://www.wowhead.com/item=184216/stoneborn-bodyguards-shoulderplates 
  • Common Grand Inquisitor drops:
    • https://www.wowhead.com/item=177803/grand-inquisitors-stave (Cloth classes, Druids, Shamans, Monks, Evokers)
    • https://www.wowhead.com/item=184210/spiked-cudgel-of-the-inquisition (Plate classes, Rogues, Shamans, Monks)

As you can see, you need to run The Avowed on classes of all 4 armor types.

Other Considerations

  • Technically, each class has a Legendary Runecarver memory item unique to each Covenant. While very bothersome, you can just run a character through each Covenant real quick to get those and learn them in Torghast, with no further commitment.
  • As much as possible, try to have your main Covenant characters be Engineers. Travelling through the Shadowlands is a nightmare without a wormhole.
  • Nathria weapon tokens like https://www.wowhead.com/item=183893/abominable-anima-spherule require a complex setup of Class x Covenant to be used efficiently. Having at least a character of each class spread around all the Covenants is recommended.

entry.title: Salvage Yard Appearance Sources
entry.summary: The Level 3 https://www.wowhead.com/building=141/salvage-yard building in your Garrison can be a treasure trove of appearance sources that, other than Quantum tokens, cannot be acquired in any other way. The appearances themselves can be acquired by making a class trial for each class, if you're not…
entry.content:
The Level 3 https://www.wowhead.com/building=141/salvage-yard building in your Garrison can be a treasure trove of appearance sources that, other than Quantum tokens, cannot be acquired in any other way. The appearances themselves can be acquired by making a class trial for each class, if you're not interested in collecting every source.

These appearance sources have a chance to be acquired when salvaging https://www.wowhead.com/item=140590/large-crate-of-salvage#comments, which are potential bonus rewards from Garrison missions. These:

  • Only drop while the Salvage Yard is built and level 3.
  • Are not guaranteed rewards from missions, other than level 40 (100 on WoWhead) missions.
  • Only have a chance to be rewarded from level 35-40 (95-100) missions.

Furthermore, they are not guaranteed to contain a cosmetic appearance. More commonly, they will contain Garrison Resources, various Warlords crafting reagents or follower upgrade tokens.

IMPORTANT! Do not spam-salvage these crates! Wait 2-4 seconds between each one! Salvaging them too quickly one after the other will eat your loot! Why? Spaghetti code.

Consult your ATT list to see all available appearance sources (there's lots of them).

Unlocking the Salvage Yard

Yes, if you wish to collect all these appearances, you'll need a Salvage Yard on all 11 classes that were in-game when Warlords launched. Yes, the Salvage Yard is the only level 1 building that you need to do a quest-line to unlock. Of course it is.

To get the level 1 blueprints, https://www.wowhead.com/item=111957/salvage-yard-level-1, you need be at least level 30 and somehow make your way to Spires of Arak on Draenor. Then:

  • Travel to Pinchwhistle Gearworks and pick up the following 3 quests:
    • https://www.wowhead.com/quest=35077/defungination 
    • https://www.wowhead.com/quest=35079/spore-be-gone 
    • https://www.wowhead.com/quest=36179/unwanted-pests 
  • Complete the quests, and continue the chain until you get https://www.wowhead.com/quest=35298/flame-on 
  • Complete Flame on, congratulations, you have the blueprint. It took you 15 minutes. For 11 classes, you'll have spent 3 hours doing this.
    • Bonus: You also unlock https://www.wowhead.com/quest=36062/kimzee-pinchwhistle#comments.
  • Go to the Garrison, start building the Salvage Yard level 1.
  • Buy the https://www.wowhead.com/item=111976/salvage-yard-level-2 blueprint from your Garrison Blueprints vendor, and upgrade your building when possible.
  • Complete this achievement https://www.wowhead.com/achievement=9468/salvaging-pays-off to unlock the blueprint for the level 3 Salvage Yard. You're finally done.
    • You'll have to purchase the blueprint on subsequent characters.

Optimized Collecting

The following content can be acquired on the side as part of this activity:

  • Garrison Gear Tokens

entry.title: Classic Instances
entry.summary: Usually, the best way to farm an instance these days is to send either your Druid or your Subtlety Rogue to zoom through at breakneck pace. However, if you're looking to collect everything, you won't be able to do it on a single character all…
entry.content:
Usually, the best way to farm an instance these days is to send either your Druid or your Subtlety Rogue to zoom through at breakneck pace. However, if you're looking to collect everything, you won't be able to do it on a single character all the time!

This page aims to show the absolute minimum amount of characters required to 100% an instance. You will see lists for relevant instances mentioning items that have specifc, immutable requirements for collection - generally things that are bind-on-pickup (recipes), are class-restricted (some quest rewards, Illusions), or need to be equipped to grant something (Sulfuras and its accompanying achievement).

You will not see an overly detailed list of everything available to collect. That's what ATT is for. This page exists to help you plan how to most efficiently collect everything in those instances, without having to figure it out yourself in-game!

Lastly, if something has an easier acquisition source outside a particular instance, it will not be mentioned here.

Table of Contents

  • Raids
    • Molten Core
    • Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj
    • Temple of Ahn'Qiraj
  • Dungeons
    • Blackrock Depths
    • Dire Maul
    • Singular Dungeon Requirements

Raids

Molten Core

  • Classes: Shaman
  • Professions: Leatherworking, Blacksmithing, Engineering
  • Ideally a Warrior, Paladin or Death Knight, as they are capable of equipping both Legendary weapons whose parts drop here.

There are 4 distinct loot restrictions in place:

  • BoP recipes for Leatherworking, Blacksmithing and Engineering.
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=138833/illusion-flametongue can only be learned by a Shaman.
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=19019/thunderfury-blessed-blade-of-the-windseeker can only be equipped by 9 classes.
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=17182/sulfuras-hand-of-ragnaros can only be equipped by 6 classes.

Naturally, for the low-drop nature of the items required to create the legendary weapons, running multiple eligible characters through Molten Core is advised.

Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj

  • Classes: All the original classes from 2004.
  • Professions: Blacksmithing, Enchanting

There are 3 distinct loot restrictions in place:

  • Each of the original Classic classes has 2 quests which award a Cloak and a Weapon (class-restricted). To complete these quests, quest items from the bosses in Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj are required.
    • To complete the Weapon quest, characters must be Exalted with the Cenarion Circle.
  • A vendor sells 2 Blacksmithing Plans after the General Rajaxx encounter (see ATT tooltip for information on how to trigger him).
    • These recipes can be bought at Revered and Exalted with Cenarion Circle
  • Seven Bind-on-Pickup Enchanting recipes have a small chance to drop from any boss in this raid as well as the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj. They are more quickly farmed here than in the Temple.
    • 2 of these recipes are also sold by certain reputation vendors in Outland, meaning only 5 of them are exclusive common boss drops to these two instances.

Temple of Ahn'Qiraj

  • Classes: All the original classes from 2004.
  • Professions: Enchanting

There are 3 distinct loot restrictions in place:

  • Each of the original Classic classes has 5 quests which award tier piece armor. To complete these quests:
    • Items that drop from bosses in the Temple are required.
    • Up to Honored reputation with Brood of Nozdormu is required.
  • The same Enchanting recipes in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj drop here as well, in the same manner.
  • A class able to deal Frost damage and have quick attack speed to defeat Viscidus*.

There are also 2 quests to acquire Weapon appearances. These may be completed on any class and will award all other appearances from the quest.

*A class that is able to deal Frost damage and have quick attack speed. Generally, this is one of the following:

    • A Rogue with a Weapon Enchant that deals Frost damage.
    • A Frost Death Knight with two one-handed weapons equipped, though this raises the minimum character composition by 1.
    • See the comments on the https://www.wowhead.com/npc=15299/viscidus page for a plethora of other strategies on how to tackle this boss, including using minions spawned from trinkets!

Dungeons

Blackrock Depths

  • Professions: Jewelcrafting, Enchanting, Blacksmithing, Alchemy

There are 4 distinct loot restrictions in place:

  • A BoP Jewelcrafting recipe that drops from Golem Lord Argelmach.
  • A BoP Enchanting recipe that drops from Lord Roccor.
  • Two BoP Blacksmithing recipes that spawn as interactable objects throughout the dungeon.
  • A BoP Alchemy recipe that is sold by Plugger Spazzring

Furthermore, the Thorium Brotherhood quartermaster resides here. Getting reputation with them is easy (see link) and can be done through many avenues not directly related to this dungeon, so we won't cover that here. For reference, the following professions have recipes sold by the quartermaster: Enchanting, Leatherworking, Tailoring, Blacksmithing, Alchemy.

Dire Maul

  • Classes: Warlock
  • Professions: Leatherworking, Tailoring, Cooking

There are 4 distinct loot restrictions in place:

  • Pusilin drops https://www.wowhead.com/item=207297/grimoire-of-the-felblaze-imp, only for Warlocks.
  • Pusilin also drops https://www.wowhead.com/item=18267/recipe-runn-tum-tuber-surprise, a BoP Cooking recipe.
  • https://www.wowhead.com/npc=14338/knot-thimblejack teaches https://www.wowhead.com/spell=22813/gordok-ogre-suit for Tailors and https://www.wowhead.com/spell=22815/gordok-ogre-suit (again) for Leatherworkers.

Small Dungeon Requirements

The following table lists dungeons that have few things to collect that are restricted in some way:

entry.content:
Quite a lot of appearance sources come from randomized Garrison content. Regarding gear tokens in Garrison content, accessing them can be confusing and stat squishes have made it downright mysterious.

There are five sets of gear tokens from Garrison content, as follows:

https://www.wowhead.com/item=114108/tormented-armament (34) https://www.wowhead.com/item=114109/munificent-armament  https://www.wowhead.com/item=114110/turbulent-armament  https://www.wowhead.com/item=114112/grandiose-armament  https://www.wowhead.com/item=114111/formidable-armament

https://www.wowhead.com/item=114100/tormented-spaulders (39) https://www.wowhead.com/item=114063/munificent-spaulders  https://www.wowhead.com/item=114075/turbulent-spaulders  https://www.wowhead.com/item=114085/grandiose-spaulders  https://www.wowhead.com/item=114091/formidable-spaulders

Table of Contents

  • Mission Spawning Requirements

Mission Spawning Requirements

Each type of mission, and sometimes each mission itself, has different requirements to be spawned. See the table below:

Token Type Follower amount and level Player item level
Tormented 1 x 31-39* Any
Munificent   44 or lower**
Turbulent 3 x 630+ 44 or lower**
Grandiose 3 x 645+ 44 or lower**

*See the first table on the page, in which the Tormented items have a number next to them. In order for their mission to spawn, you must have a follower of that exact level. It does not matter if the follower is active or inactive.
**This terribly low item level can be achieved by either leveling a new character and keeping it below the threshold, or deleting gear on a high-level character. Note that keeping gear in bags will not work, as that is also included in the calculation.

In addition, it seems more likely that missions spawn the more followers you have. It is unknown at this time whether more followers of a specific level results in more chances of missions of that specific level spawning.

Finally, if you're looking to do this with as few characters as possible, your main concern are the weapon tokens. The following setup gives you the chance to get all possible weapon appearances:

  • Priest (Spires, Scepters)
  • Rogue (Daggers, Axes, Warmaces)
  • Hunter (Bows, Polearms)
  • Any Plate class (Greataxes, Axes) - Paladins can also get Warmaces

Turbulent Gear Tokens

The following four tokens can only be acquired at random from the https://www.wowhead.com/item=118924/cache-of-arms#contains, a reward from the Garrison Inn quest https://www.wowhead.com/quest=37167/and-no-maces:

  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=114073/turbulent-hood
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=114072/turbulent-gauntlets
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=114074/turbulent-leggings
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=114079/turbulent-cloak

It is possible the quest may not be offered by the NPC at all Inn levels, which would explain why some characters will have a different quest available. Also note the quest always rewards 2 tokens - one cloak, and one of the others. Furthermore, the quest is not repeatable. You'll need to throw an army of alts at this, especially if you want the cloak sources.

Grandiose Gear Tokens

Unfortunately, there are missions only for the following tokens:

  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=114112/grandiose-armament
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=114085/grandiose-spaulders
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=114083/grandiose-robes
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=114082/grandiose-bracers
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=114084/grandiose-treads
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=114086/grandiose-choker

The other tokens can only be found in https://www.wowhead.com/item=123975/greater-bounty-spoils. Read more about how to get these bags in the next section. This means you'll need this bag reward for the following tokens:

  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=119116/grandiose-hood
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=119114/grandiose-gauntlets
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=119118/grandiose-leggings
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=119124/grandiose-cloak
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=119120/grandiose-girdle
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=119122/grandiose-ring

Formidable Tokens & Greater Bounty Spoils

Formidable tokens cannot be acquired through Garrison missions. They can only be obtained from https://www.wowhead.com/item=123975/greater-bounty-spoils. This means that, upon opening this bag, you have a chance at receiving either a Grandiose or a Formidable token. If you're targeting a specific token, this means you have a 1/26 chance of actually getting it, once per week, per character.

Here's a breakdown of how to get https://www.wowhead.com/item=123975/greater-bounty-spoils:

  • Every day, you have a visitor in your Tier 3 Garrison. Sometimes a vendor, sometimes a questgiver.
    • You're looking to find https://www.wowhead.com/npc=89753/high-overlord-saurfang (Horde)
    • Or https://www.wowhead.com/npc=89763/muradin-bronzebeard (Alliance)
    • If he's not up in your Garrison, you can totally visit a friend's Garrison if they have him.
  • When spawned, you will be offered a quest to kill the final boss of a WOD raid wing.
    • Once you complete one of these quests, you're locked from accepting any more until the weekly reset.
    • There are 12 quests in total, on a fixed rotation.
    • Five of them, sending you to Hellfire Citadel, award Apexis Crystals instead of Greater Bounty Spoils.
  • Pick up the quest, go into the specified LFR wing via https://www.wowhead.com/npc=94870/seer-kazal and complete the quest.
  • Once completed, that character cannot acquire Greater Bounty Spoils until the weekly reset.

From personal testing, Grandiose tokens seem far more common than Formidable tokens.

Notes

  • Garrison missions spawn randomly. Some day you may find a mission for a token, other days not.
  • You can purchase https://www.wowhead.com/item=128307/draenic-weaponry and https://www.wowhead.com/item=128308/draenic-armor-set from the <Local Supplies> vendor near your Mission Table to quickly give a level 40 follower a high item level. The vendor only appears in Level 3 Garrisons.
  • Alternatively, https://www.wowhead.com/item=128314/frozen-arms-of-a-hero can be used.
  • Sometimes you may see a Grandiose mission with only two 645+ followers. It's unclear what triggers it.
